name: The Cursed Crew
summary: Off the Wetlands coast, The Cursed Crew still haunts its sunken ships. First Mate Fitzsimmons, the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras's sole living survivor, asks for mercy for his lost brethren. A dark relic aboard one of the wrecks binds the drowned sailors and marines to the ships as restless undead.

sections.title: A Restless Fleet
sections.body: The Third Fleet of Kul Tiras wrecked along the jagged shores north of Menethil Harbor. First Mate Fitzsimmons alone made it ashore alive. His fellow sailors did not find peace beneath the waves. A mysterious treasure hidden deep in one of the hulls unleashed sorcery as they died. It bound their souls to the battered timbers and denied them the grave's rest.

sections.title: Mercy by the Blade
sections.body: First Mate Fitzsimmons still hears his former shipmates' moans and cries at night in the taverns of Menethil Harbor. He believes that striking down their animated corpses can release them from their torment. He sends travelers into the rotting, drowned hulks to kill the cursed sailors, the seasoned marines, and his former peer, First Mate Snellig. Fitzsimmons asks them to bring back Snellig's personal snuffbox as proof that his friend has finally been laid to rest.

faq.answer: First Mate Snellig served aboard the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras with First Mate Fitzsimmons. Snellig drowned with the crew when the fleet wrecked off the northern Wetlands coast. A malevolent relic aboard the ships raised him as an undead horror, now haunting a flooded hold in one of the wrecks.

faq.q: Why are the sailors and marines cursed?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons says a concealed, malignant treasure was aboard one of the fleet's vessels. When the ships wrecked along the coast, the artifact's dark energies bound the drowned crew's spirits to their rotting hulls, barring their passage beyond and condemning them to undead torment.

faq.q: Where are the sunken ships located?
faq.answer: The Third Fleet's ruined ships lie submerged off the northern Wetlands coast, north of Menethil Harbor. The cursed crew prowls the decks and surrounding waters, while Snellig haunts the cracked hull of the southern vessel.

faq.q: Why does Fitzsimmons want Snellig's snuffbox?
faq.answer: First Mate Snellig's snuffbox was his personal keepsake in life. Returning it to Fitzsimmons proves that his cursed comrade has been released from his rotting prison beneath the waves.

First Mate Fitzsimmons is a Kul Tiran sailor and the Third Fleet's only known living survivor. Grief and guilt keep him in Menethil Harbor, haunted by nightmares of his drowned brothers and seeking travelers to end their suffering.

faq.q: Does killing the crew actually break the curse?
faq.answer: Striking down the sailors and marines gives their restless spirits temporary respite, but does not break the enchantment. The mysterious relic hidden aboard the wreckage remains at the curse's root.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you share a solemn duty to lay these tormented Kul Tiran sailors to rest. Kul Tiras has long supplied the Grand Alliance with its finest sailors.
As a paladin, you can lay the innocent sailors to rest and cleanse the profane desecration wrought upon them, bringing light to dark waters.
As a human traveler, you may feel kinship with these fallen sailors through the shared naval traditions of the kingdom of Kul Tiras.
